result.summary: JUnit 5 suite for all 33 planned cases (77 tests): MockMvc integration over an isolated in-memory H2, unit tests for destination policy and code generation, full-app restart test on a file-based store

decisions.choice: Integration tests share one Spring context over jdbc:h2:mem with a random name, a settable MutableClock and a StubHostResolver; unique aliases per test
decisions.rationale: Deterministic expiry boundaries and no real DNS, without restarting Spring per test

decisions.choice: All test classes end in Test
decisions.rationale: Surefire runs only *Test/*Tests/Test*/*TestCase under mvn test; *IT classes would be silently skipped by the gate

decisions.choice: The 503 path is tested against HealthController with a JdbcTemplate that refuses connections, not by stopping the shared database
decisions.rationale: Stopping the shared store would break every other test in the context

decisions.choice: Verified that no HTTP client beans exist and that create plus redirect perform exactly one DNS lookup through the resolver and no other network access
decisions.rationale: The service has no outbound HTTP code path to spy on; these are the observable guarantees

decisions.choice: Limiter reset is checked with a fresh CreateRateLimiter, and again by the full application restart in PersistenceRestartTest
decisions.rationale: State is in-memory by design, so a new instance is exactly what a restart produces

decisions.choice: The real application is started twice with SpringApplicationBuilder on a @TempDir data directory, passing settings as command-line args
decisions.rationale: builder.properties() are defaults that application.yml overrides; an earlier draft silently used ./data and the file-existence assertion caught it

decisions.choice: Satisfied by the suite as a whole (every case id appears as a test method), not a separate executable test
decisions.rationale: A test asserting that tests exist adds no verification

decisions.choice: No implementation defects found; all 77 tests pass against the implementation as shown (redirect p99 about 2 ms locally)
decisions.rationale: Recorded so the absence of defects is an explicit finding
